## Overview (this PR description was manually written by me) This is an NVIDIA-developed specialized implementation of Kimi K3 for GB300 that achieves 1.5-2x decode speedups. It supports: - TP8 and TP16 on GB300 - NoSpec (up to B64) and DSpark verification with 3-7 draft tokens (up to 64 tokens -- B8 for DL7, B16 for DL3) - Decode context parallelism with DCP=TP (DCP-off also supported) It is enabled opt-in via `--additional-config '{"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}'`. All changes are localized to `vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/`. ## Claims With FP8 KV Cache, FP32 SSM Cache, and model-provider weights: - TP16, ISL 1, no speculation: decode step **1.79-1.92x faster than stock at B1-B8** (3.90 vs 7.38 ms at B1). - TP16, DSpark DL7, synthetic acceptance 6: **1.53-1.71x decode tok/s at B1-B8**. - DL7, ISL 32k, DCP on: **1.36-1.50x (TP8)** and **1.53-1.75x (TP16)** decode tok/s. - AIME25, GPQA-Diamond and MRCR v2 8-needle match stock within about one standard error, with and without speculation. ## Validation ### Correctness Testing Evals for this branch ran with DCP = TP (TP8+DCP8 and TP16+DCP16); stock ran on TP8 without DCP, C2 and C8 pooled. Spec on = DSpark DL7 with probabilistic drafting and standard rejection sampling (no forced acceptance). Score ± standard error, n samples per cell; pooling ours' C2 and C8 cells gives AIME25 avg@4, GPQA-Diamond avg@2, GSM8k avg@2. MRCR v2: 8-needle, (128k, 256k] contexts, thinking on, 32k output cap. | Task | Spec | Stock TP8 | Ours TP8+DCP8 C2 | Ours TP8+DCP8 C8 | Ours TP16+DCP16 C2 | Ours TP16+DCP16 C8 | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | AIME25 | off | 0.867 ± 0.033 (n=120) | 0.867 ± 0.048 | 0.917 ± 0.035 | 0.900 ± 0.037 | 0.900 ± 0.037 | | AIME25 | DL7 | 0.892 ± 0.032 (n=120) | 0.917 ± 0.042 | 0.900 ± 0.037 | 0.883 ± 0.052 | 0.950 ± 0.037 | | GPQA-D | off | 0.924 ± 0.011 (n=594) | 0.919 ± 0.019 | 0.914 ± 0.020 | 0.919 ± 0.019 | 0.929 ± 0.018 | | GPQA-D | DL7 | 0.916 ± 0.011 (n=594) | 0.939 ± 0.017 | 0.929 ± 0.018 | 0.919 ± 0.019 | 0.955 ± 0.015 | | GSM8k | off | 0.867 ± 0.009 (n=1319) | 0.856 ± 0.010 | 0.860 ± 0.010 | 0.864 ± 0.009 | 0.873 ± 0.009 | | GSM8k | DL7 | 0.863 ± 0.005 (n=5276) | 0.853 ± 0.010 | 0.854 ± 0.010 | 0.868 ± 0.009 | 0.865 ± 0.009 | | MRCR v2 | off | 0.282 ± 0.039 (n=100) | 0.334 ± 0.042 | 0.226 ± 0.036 | – | – | | MRCR v2 | DL7 | 0.343 ± 0.042 (n=100) | 0.339 ± 0.042 | 0.320 ± 0.042 | – | – | Sample counts: AIME25 n=60, GPQA-D n=198, GSM8k n=1319, MRCR n=100. Single MRCR runs swing by ~0.1 between repeats; a larger TP8 C8 matrix ({ours, stock} x {DCP on, off} x {spec off, DL7}, 750–900 samples per build) gives **0.296 (ours) vs 0.290 (stock)**.
Numerical validation and the MRCR output-length study - **Greedy logprobs, spec vs no-spec on the same build** (up to and including the first divergence): TP8 drift ≤ 0.50 vs stock's own 0.38, divergences only at near-ties (top-1/top-2 margin ≤ 0.50); TP8+DCP8 (~8k context) drift ≤ 0.38, margins ≤ 0.375, inside stock's B1-vs-B4 noise of 0.875. :heavy_check_mark: - **Greedy probes at 128k–256k context vs stock** (32 MRCR prompts, 4096 tokens, top-10 logprobs): every divergence is at an exact BF16 top-1/top-2 tie; ours-vs-stock |Δ logprob| (0.007–0.009, first divergence ~step 50–80) matches stock DCP-on vs DCP-off (0.014, ~59); no growth with position. Same with DL7. :heavy_check_mark: - **Per-step error vs a 1-ulp noise floor** (stock re-run with 1-ulp-perturbed embeddings on the same state), out to 245k context with and without DCP: KL, top-1 agreement, hidden-state, KDA-state and KV differences all equal the floor; accumulated drift over 1536 consecutive decodes equals the accumulated floor. Prefill is bit-identical to stock. :heavy_check_mark: - **Decode vs prefill rescoring** (CUDA graphs, sampling, 8192 tokens; the same server then rescores the text via prefill logprobs): per-token decode-minus-prefill logprob, stratified by confidence, is identical to stock's in all configs and flat with depth. :heavy_check_mark: - **Output length:** At low cap (32k), we see many truncations and slightly more for ours than baseline. This remains unclear, as there is very high variance and the mean OSL at 32k is a bit higher. With a 64k cap (100 samples per config), we see very few truncations and mean output length is comparable. : | build | config | mean | std | capped at 64k | |---|---|---|---|---| | ours | DCP, spec off | 8757 | 13515 | 3 | | ours | DCP, DL7 | 7540 | 12612 | 2 | | ours | no DCP, spec off | 6987 | 9577 | 0 | | ours | no DCP, DL7 | 11891 | 19250 | 9 | | stock | DCP, spec off | 9458 | 12858 | 1 | | stock | DCP, DL7 | 10634 | 16039 | 5 | | stock | no DCP, spec off | 9083 | 14634 | 4 | | stock | no DCP, DL7 | 10526 | 16881 | 5 |
### Performance Validation **TP16, no speculation, ISL 1, OSL 1024, greedy.** Decode step = median ITL at exactly B running requests (prefill excluded), cross-checked against nsys graph-replay time. 3 runs x 4 prompts per B. | | B1 | B2 | B4 | B8 | |---|---|---|---|---| | ours, step ms | 3.90 | 4.58 | 5.75 | 6.82 | | stock, step ms | 7.38 | 8.79 | 10.33 | 12.19 | | **speedup** | **1.89x** | **1.92x** | **1.80x** | **1.79x** | | decode tok/s, ours / stock | 255 / 135 | 439 / 227 | 695 / 387 | 1156 / 649 | **TP16, DSpark DL7, synthetic acceptance length 6, ISL 1.** Decode tok/s = decode steps/s x acceptance length x B. | | B1 (M8) | B2 (M16) | B4 (M32) | B8 (M64) | |---|---|---|---|---| | ours | 838 | 1361 | 2091 | 3094 | | stock | 489 | 847 | 1366 | 2014 | | **speedup** | **1.71x** | **1.61x** | **1.53x** | **1.54x** | **DSpark DL7, synthetic acceptance 3.78, ISL 32k (SPEED-Bench mixed prompts), DCP on.** Stock baseline with `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --dcp-comm-backend a2a --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune`, same for ours. Decode tok/s excludes prefill; output tok/s and TPOT include the other requests' 16k prefill chunks, so their gains are smaller. TTFT is at parity. | B | TP8+DCP8 decode tok/s, ours / stock | output tok/s | TPOT ms, ours / stock | TP16+DCP16 decode tok/s, ours / stock | output tok/s | TPOT ms, ours / stock | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | 374 / 249 (**1.50x**) | 1.32x | 2.68 / 4.02 | 483 / 276 (**1.75x**) | 1.49x | 2.08 / 3.63 | | 2 | 625 / 420 (**1.49x**) | 1.16x | 3.87 / 5.41 | 775 / 473 (**1.64x**) | 1.35x | 3.10 / 4.72 | | 4 | 875 / 625 (**1.40x**) | 1.18x | 7.14 / 8.91 | 1156 / 750 (**1.54x**) | 1.24x | 5.45 / 7.28 | | 8 | 1233 / 904 (**1.36x**) | 1.14x | 11.92 / 13.91 | 1667 / 1088 (**1.53x**) | 1.20x | 9.70 / 12.30 | ### Full matrix (nsys decode step, stock / ours) SPEED-Bench mixed prompts at ISL 8k / 32k / 100k; DSpark DL3 at forced acceptance 2.87, DL7 at 3.78.
TP8 (complete) and TP16 (partial) **TP8, no DCP, spec off** (step time ratio, B1/2/4/8/16/32/64): | ISL | B1 | B2 | B4 | B8 | B16 | B32 | B64 | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 8k | 1.65x | 1.52x | 1.55x | 1.59x | 1.44x | 1.35x | 1.31x | | 32k | 1.65x | 1.52x | 1.57x | 1.45x | 1.42x | 1.33x | 1.32x | | 100k | 1.66x | 1.50x | 1.52x | 1.40x | 1.39x | 1.32x | (KV) | 8k step us, stock -> ours: 8673->5254, 9799->6434, 11663->7505, 15490->9745, 17373->12104, 23873->17648, 33664->25709. **TP8+DCP8, spec off, 100k:** 1.69 / 1.58 / 1.60 / 1.49 / 1.45 / 1.36 / 1.31x (step us 9387->5550 ... 34903->26638). **TP8, DL3 (AL 2.87), B1–B16 = M4–M64:** | ISL | B1 | B2 | B4 | B8 | B16 | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 8k verify forward | 1.68x | 1.58x | 1.51x | 1.40x | 1.36x | | 8k step | 1.61x | 1.52x | 1.47x | 1.37x | 1.34x | | 32k step | 1.58x | 1.51x | 1.47x | 1.36x | 1.37x | | 100k step | 1.55x | 1.51x | 1.42x | 1.31x | 1.28x | 8k decode tok/s, ours vs stock: 373/619/977/1410/1931 vs 239/413/672/1009/1435. **TP8, DL7 (AL 3.78), B1–B8 = M8–M64:** | ISL | B1 | B2 | B4 | B8 | |---|---|---|---|---| | 8k verify forward | 1.62x | 1.52x | 1.41x | 1.41x | | 8k step | 1.57x | 1.47x | 1.38x | 1.38x | | 32k step | 1.45x | 1.47x | 1.39x | 1.37x | | 100k step | 1.44x | 1.45x | 1.34x | 1.34x | 8k step ms, ours vs stock: 9.6/11.5/16.4/23.2 vs 15.1/16.9/22.6/32.1.
## Details ### vLLM Integration No weight changes were made in this model implementation: it is fully compatible with Aggregated vLLM serving, and falls back to the default implementation for prefills, mixed batches, and large batches. The specialized decode runtime is implemented via _composition_: a SpecializedDecode object owned by the Kimi LLM model, built when supported (see `unsupported(...)`), and called during forward(). The runtime can opt-out of a batch (e.g. when it has too many tokens) by checking `decode.plan(...) is None`, and fall back to stock forward. I considered a few alternate designs but ultimately feel like this is the cleanest integration. It uses the ModelState protocol to build the runtime object and hook into initialize_kv_cache(). The rest of the integration is organized into subfolders, e.g. `vllm/models/kimi_k3/specialized_decode/nvidia/cutedsl/kda/` with the specialized implementation(s) for each component. ---

(Omitted -- I reviewed all the code manually and did multiple cleanup passes internally before opening the PR here). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. **I am happy with the validation, but still unclear how much we want to put into CI. I may yet add a GSM8k sanity check to CI** - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

 )
+from .specialized_decode.runtime import specialized_decode_config
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:

 logger = init_logger(__name__)
 
@@ -1421,8 +1427,34 @@ def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
         self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(
             self.config.vocab_size, scale=logit_scale
         )
+        # decode_backend=latency_specialized: a specialized decode executor over
+        # self.model, built by the model state once the weights are loaded.
+        self.specialized_decode_config = specialized_decode_config(vllm_config)
+        self.specialized_decode: SpecializedDecode | None = None
+        # The final norm is applied in compute_logits unless the specialized decode
+        # applies it in forward.
+        self.needs_norm_in_logits = True
+
+    def build_specialized_decode(self) -> None:
+        from .specialized_decode.runtime.decode import SpecializedDecode
+
+        self.specialized_decode = SpecializedDecode(
+            self.model, self.specialized_decode_config

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Seven-CTA cluster AttnRes: one cluster per token, 1024 hidden columns per CTA.
+
+The delta is a tensor (read after the PDL wait) or ``slots`` Lamport mailbox slots
+summed in slot order, rounded to BF16 and re-armed. The final boundary rounds the
+mixture to BF16 before its RMSNorm. Prefix and saved blocks must be complete at launch.
+"""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Uint32, Uint64
+
+from ..common.mailbox import poll, rearm
+from ..common.primitives import (
+    alloc,
+    at,
+    bf16,
+    bf16x2,
+    dot,
+    fma,
+    group_barrier,
+    launch,
+    load_words,
+    push_float,
+    scatter_reduce,
+    store_words,
+    wait,
+    zeros,
+)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def round_pair(t, row: cutlass.Constexpr, j: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    word = bf16x2(t[row, 2 * j], t[row, 2 * j + 1])
+    t[row, 2 * j], t[row, 2 * j + 1] = bf16(word, 0), bf16(word, 1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def unpack(words, out, row: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        out[row, i] = bf16(words[i // 2], i % 2)
+
+
+def block_ptr(blocks, token, block, col):
+    """``&blocks[token, block, col]`` from the tensor's strides."""
+    return blocks.iterator + token * blocks.stride[0] + block * blocks.stride[1] + col
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def rstd(sum_sq, eps):
+    """Reciprocal RMS of a 7168-wide row from its sum of squares."""
+    return cute.math.rsqrt(fma(sum_sq, Float32(1 / 7168), eps), fastmath=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def dot8(a, ar: cutlass.Constexpr, b, br: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    return dot((a[ar, i] for i in range(8)), (b[br, i] for i in range(8)), Float32(0))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def arm_exchanges(bars, counts):
+    """Thread 0 arms barrier ``r`` for ``counts[r]`` FP32 pushes from each of 7 CTAs."""
+    if cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] == 0:
+        for r, count in enumerate(counts):
+            if cutlass.const_expr(count > 0):
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(bars.iterator + r, 1)
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive_and_expect_tx(bars.iterator + r, 28 * count)
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_init_fence()
+
+
+class ClusterAttnRes:
+    def __init__(self, nb, *, slots=1, has_delta=True, write=-1, final=False):
+        self.nb, self.slots, self.has_delta = nb, slots, has_delta
+        self.write, self.final = write, final
+        self.npre = 2 * nb
+        self.npost = (2 if final else 4) if nb else 1
+        self.kpre = 1 << max(self.npre - 1, 0).bit_length()
+        self.kpost = 1 << max(self.npost - 1, 0).bit_length()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        launch(self.kernel, args, (7, args[1].shape[0], 1), 128, 7)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def exchange(
+        self, values, count: cutlass.Constexpr, kpad: cutlass.Constexpr, bufs, r, ids
+    ):
+        """Cluster-sum ``count`` per-thread partials into round ``r``'s total row."""
+        wb, peer_buf, total, bars = bufs
+        peer_buf, total, bar = peer_buf[r, None], total[r, None], bars.iterator + r
+        rank, _, tid = ids
+        lane, warp = tid % 32, tid // 32
+        reduced, index = scatter_reduce(values, lane, kpad)
+        if (lane & (32 // kpad - 1)) == 0 and index < count:
+            wb[warp * 16 + index] = reduced
+        group_barrier(0)
+        if tid < count:
+            value = (wb[tid] + wb[16 + tid]) + (wb[32 + tid] + wb[48 + tid])
+            for peer in cutlass.range_constexpr(7):
+                push_float(peer_buf.iterator + rank * 16 + tid, value, bar, Int32(peer))
+        wait(bar)
+        if tid < count:
+            sums = [Float32(0), Float32(0)]
+            for peer in cutlass.range_constexpr(7):
+                sums[peer % 2] += peer_buf[peer * 16 + tid]
+            total[tid] = sums[0] + sums[1]
+        group_barrier(0)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        delta, prefix, blocks, norm, query, out_norm, output, eps, out_eps = args[0:9]
+        rank, token, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        bufs = self.setup(cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator())
+        cute.arch.cluster_arrive_relaxed()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        state = self.state()
+        rows, ids = (prefix, blocks, norm, query, out_norm), (rank, token, tid)
+        self.pre(state, bufs, rows, eps, ids)
+        self.post(state, bufs, delta, rows, output, eps, out_eps, ids, args[9:])
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+
+    def state(self):
+        """Carried from pre() to post(); the rest reloads so a GEMM can run between."""
+        return cute.make_rmem_tensor((1, 8), Float32), cute.make_rmem_tensor(2, Float32)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def setup(self, smem):
+        warp_buf = alloc(smem, Float32, 64)
+        peer_buf = alloc(smem, Float32, (3, 112))
+        total = alloc(smem, Float32, (3, 16))
+        bars = alloc(smem, Uint64, 3, 8)
+        arm_exchanges(bars, (self.npre, self.npost, int(self.final)))
+        return warp_buf, peer_buf, total, bars
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def pre(self, state, bufs, rows, eps: Float32, ids):
+        """Inputs complete at launch, then the saved-block statistics exchange."""
+        prefix, blocks, norm, query, out_norm = rows
+        rank, token, tid = ids
+        warp_buf, peer_buf, total, bars = bufs
+        mixture, scal = state
+        # Rows: saved blocks, combined weight, gamma, old prefix, new prefix.
+        v = cute.make_rmem_tensor((self.nb + 4, 8), Float32)
+        col = (rank * 128 + tid) * 8
+        W = self.nb
+        for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.nb):
+            words = load_words(
+                block_ptr(blocks, token, source, col), count=4, mutable=True
+            )
+            unpack(words, v, source)
+        self.weights(v, norm, query, col)
+        cute.arch.cluster_wait()
+        maximum, exp_sum = Float32(0), Float32(0)
+        mixture.fill(0)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.nb > 0):
+            values = zeros(self.kpre, Float32)
+            for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.nb):
+                values[source] = dot8(v, source, v, source)
+                values[self.nb + source] = dot8(v, source, v, W)
+            self.exchange(values, self.npre, self.kpre, bufs, 0, ids)
+            logits = cute.make_rmem_tensor(self.nb, Float32)
+            for b in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.nb):
+                logits[b] = total[0, self.nb + b] * rstd(total[0, b], eps)
+            maximum = logits[0]
+            for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, self.nb):
+                maximum = cute.arch.fmax(maximum, logits[source])
+            for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.nb):
+                e = cute.math.exp(logits[source] - maximum, fastmath=True)
+                exp_sum += e
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    mixture[0, i] = fma(e, v[source, i], mixture[0, i])
+        scal[0], scal[1] = maximum, exp_sum
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def weights(self, v, norm, query, col):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.nb > 0):
+            nw = load_words(norm.iterator + col, count=4)
+            qw = load_words(query.iterator + col, count=4)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                v[self.nb, i] = bf16(nw[i // 2], i % 2) * bf16(qw[i // 2], i % 2)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def post(
+        self, state, bufs, delta, rows, output, eps: Float32, out_eps: Float32, ids, aux
+    ):
+        """Add the delta, update prefix (and its ``aux`` copy) and saved block, write
+        the normalized output."""
+        prefix, blocks, norm, query, out_norm = rows
+        rank, token, tid = ids
+        warp_buf, peer_buf, total, bars = bufs
+        mixture, scal = state
+        maximum, exp_sum = scal[0], scal[1]
+        v = cute.make_rmem_tensor((self.nb + 4, 8), Float32)
+        col = (rank * 128 + tid) * 8
+        W, G, OLD, NEW = self.nb, self.nb + 1, self.nb + 2, self.nb + 3
+        self.weights(v, norm, query, col)
+        unpack(load_words(out_norm.iterator + col, count=4), v, G)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.has_delta):
+            unpack(load_words(at(prefix, token, col), count=4, mutable=True), v, OLD)
+        cur = cute.make_rmem_tensor((1, 8), Float32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.slots == 0):
+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+            unpack(load_words(at(delta, token, col), count=4, mutable=True), cur, 0)
+        else:
+            cur.fill(0)
+            base = delta.iterator + token * 7168 + col
+            got = poll(base, delta.shape[1] * 7168, self.slots)
+            for slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.slots):
+                rearm(base + slot * delta.shape[1] * 7168)
+                part = cute.make_rmem_tensor((1, 8), Float32)
+                unpack(tuple(got[slot, k] for k in range(4)), part, 0)
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    cur[0, i] = cur[0, i] + part[0, i]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.slots > 1):
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):  # all-reduce output boundary
+                    round_pair(cur, 0, j)
+        words = cute.make_rmem_tensor(4, Uint32)
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            lo, hi = cur[0, 2 * j], cur[0, 2 * j + 1]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.has_delta):
+                lo, hi = v[OLD, 2 * j] + lo, v[OLD, 2 * j + 1] + hi
+            words[j] = bf16x2(lo, hi)
+        unpack(words, v, NEW)
+        values = zeros(self.kpost, Float32)
+        values[0] = dot8(v, NEW, v, NEW)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.nb > 0):
+            values[1] = dot8(v, NEW, v, W)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(not self.final):
+                values[2] = dot8(mixture, 0, v, NEW)
+                values[3] = dot8(mixture, 0, mixture, 0)
+        self.exchange(values, self.npost, self.kpost, bufs, 1, ids)
+        row = (words[0], words[1], words[2], words[3])
+        store_words(at(prefix, token, col), row)
+        for stream_out in aux:
+            store_words(at(stream_out, token, col), row)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.write >= 0):
+            store_words(block_ptr(blocks, token, self.write, col), row)
+        result = cute.make_rmem_tensor((1, 8), Float32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.nb == 0):
+            scale = rstd(total[1, 0], out_eps)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                result[0, i] = v[NEW, i] * scale * v[G, i]
+        else:
+            ss, dot = total[1, 0], total[1, 1]
+            logit = dot * rstd(ss, eps)
+            top = cute.arch.fmax(maximum, logit)
+            alpha = cute.math.exp(maximum - top, fastmath=True)
+            ep = cute.math.exp(logit - top, fastmath=True)
+            denominator = fma(alpha, exp_sum, ep)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.final):
+                inverse = Float32(1) / denominator
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    for i in (2 * j, 2 * j + 1):
+                        result[0, i] = fma(
+                            alpha * inverse, mixture[0, i], ep * inverse * v[NEW, i]
+                        )
+                    round_pair(result, 0, j)
+                fin = cute.make_rmem_tensor(1, Float32)
+                fin[0] = dot8(result, 0, result, 0)
+                self.exchange(fin, 1, 1, bufs, 2, ids)
+                scale = rstd(total[2, 0], out_eps)
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    result[0, i] = result[0, i] * scale * v[G, i]
+            else:
+                a2, t3 = alpha * alpha, total[1, 3]
+                ae2 = Float32(2) * alpha * ep
+                quad = fma(a2, t3, fma(ae2, total[1, 2], ep * ep * ss))
+                scale = rstd(quad, out_eps * denominator * denominator)
+                ca, cp = alpha * scale, ep * scale
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    result[0, i] = fma(ca, mixture[0, i], cp * v[NEW, i]) * v[G, i]
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            words[j] = bf16x2(result[0, 2 * j], result[0, 2 * j + 1])
+        store_words(at(output, token, col), tuple(words[j] for j in range(4)))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Prepared seven-CTA AttnRes consumers for ordinary or Lamport mailbox input."""
+
+from functools import cache
+from typing import Any
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+from ..common.host import (
+    architecture,
+    dynamic_fake,
+    dynamic_view,
+    fake,
+    stream,
+    to_cute,
+)
+from .kernel import ClusterAttnRes
+
+
+@cache
+def compile_consumer(nb, delta, write, final, slots, cap, arch, aux=False):
+    row, weight, eps = dynamic_fake(2), fake((7168,), (1,)), cutlass.Float32(1e-6)
+    source = fake((slots, cap, 7168), (cap * 7168, 7168, 1)) if slots else row
+    kernel = ClusterAttnRes(nb, slots=slots, has_delta=delta, write=write, final=final)
+    args = (source, row, dynamic_fake(3), weight, weight, weight, row, eps, eps)
+    args += (row,) * aux  # the updated prefix row, also stored to an aux stream
+    return cute.compile(kernel, *args, make_fake_stream(), options=f"--gpu-arch={arch}")
+
+
+class PreparedAttnRes:
+    """Ordinary-input code plus the Lamport variant of its bound mailbox ring."""
+
+    def __init__(self, weights, key, eps):
+        self.device = weights[0].device
+        self.views = tuple(to_cute(w.reshape(-1)) for w in weights)
+        self.key, self.eps = key, tuple(map(cutlass.Float32, eps))
+        self.code = self._compile(0, 0)
+        self.ring: Any = None
+        self.aux: Any = None
+
+    def _compile(self, slots, cap, aux=False):
+        arch = architecture(self.device)
+        return compile_consumer(*self.key, slots, cap, arch, aux)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def for_target(cls, target, *, final=False, has_delta=True):
+        if final:
+            norm, query = target.output_attn_res_norm, target.output_attn_res_proj
+            output, nb, write = target.norm, target.num_attn_res_blocks, -1
+        else:
+            norm = target.self_attention_res_norm
+            query, output = target.self_attention_res_proj, target.input_layernorm
+            nb = target.prev_valid_blocks
+            write = target.block_write_idx if target.is_block_write_layer else -1
+        weights = (norm.weight, query.weight, output.weight)
+        eps = (norm.variance_epsilon, output.variance_epsilon)
+        return cls(weights, (nb, has_delta, write, final), eps)
+
+    def bind_ring(self, mailbox):
+        """Lamport input: sum the [slots, capacity, 7168] mailbox rows, then re-arm."""
+        shape = tuple(mailbox.shape[:2])
+        self.ring = self._compile(*shape), to_cute(mailbox), shape
+
+    def bind_aux(self):
+        """Variants that also store the updated prefix rows (a stock aux stream)."""
+        ring = None
+        if self.ring is not None:
+            slots, cap = self.ring[2]
+            ring = self._compile(slots, cap, True)
+        self.aux = self._compile(0, 0, True), ring
+
+    def run_ring(self, prefix, blocks, out, aux=None):
+        code = self.ring[0] if aux is None else self.aux[1]
+        return self._launch(code, self.ring[1], prefix, blocks, out, aux)
+
+    def run(self, delta, prefix, blocks, out, aux=None):
+        code = self.code if aux is None else self.aux[0]
+        return self._launch(code, dynamic_view(delta), prefix, blocks, out, aux)
+
+    def _launch(self, code, source, prefix, blocks, out, aux=None):
+        rows = (prefix, blocks, out) + (() if aux is None else (aux,))
+        prefix, blocks, view, *aux = map(dynamic_view, rows)
+        args = *self.views, view, *self.eps, *aux
+        code(source, prefix, blocks, *args, stream(self.device))
+        return out

+"""Local CuTe vocabulary gather plus the ordinary framework TP all-reduce."""
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import cutlass as c
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+from .host import architecture, fake
+from .primitives import launch
+
+
+class EmbeddingGather:
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        launch(self.kernel, args, (7, args[0].shape[0], 1), 128, pdl=False)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        ids, weight, out, start, vocab = args[0:5]
+        lane, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        tile, token, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        token_id = c.Int64(ids[token])
+        row, column = token_id - start, tile * 1024 + lane * 8
+        values = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), c.BFloat16)
+        values.fill(c.BFloat16(0))
+        if (token_id >= 0) & (token_id < vocab) & (row >= 0) & (row < weight.shape[0]):
+            source = weight.iterator + row * 7168 + column
+            cute.autovec_copy(cute.make_tensor(source, cute.make_layout((8,))), values)
+        destination = out.iterator + token * 7168 + column
+        cute.autovec_copy(values, cute.make_tensor(destination, cute.make_layout((8,))))
+
+
+@cache
+def compile_gather(dtype, shard, arch):
+    batch = cute.sym_int32()
+    args: tuple = (fake((batch,), None, dtype, dtype.itemsize), fake((shard, 7168)))
+    args += (fake((batch, 7168)), c.Int64(0), c.Int64(0))
+    stream = make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=True)
+    options = f"--gpu-arch={arch} --enable-tvm-ffi"
+    return cute.compile(EmbeddingGather(), *args, stream, options=options)
+

+"""Host-side helpers for the prepared CuTe providers."""
+
+import ctypes
+import math
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_tensor
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.cute_dsl.latent_moe_tail.primitives import to_cute
+
+_NAMES = ("BFloat16", "Float32", "Uint8", "Uint32", "Int32", "Int64")
+_DTYPES = {getattr(torch, name.lower()): getattr(cutlass, name) for name in _NAMES}
+
+
+def layout(tensor):
+    return tuple(tensor.shape), tuple(tensor.stride()), tensor.dtype
+
+
+def stream(device):
+    return cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream(device).cuda_stream)
+
+
+def architecture(device):
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)
+    return f"sm_{major}{minor}a"
+
+
+def fake(shape, stride=None, dtype=torch.bfloat16, align=16):
+    """Row-major unless ``stride`` is given."""
+    stride = stride or tuple(math.prod(shape[i + 1 :]) for i in range(len(shape)))
+    dtype = _DTYPES.get(dtype, dtype)
+    return make_fake_tensor(dtype, shape, stride, assumed_align=align)
+
+
+def dynamic_fake(rank, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+    shape = tuple(cute.sym_int() for _ in range(rank))
+    return fake(shape, (*(cute.sym_int(64) for _ in range(rank - 1)), 1), dtype)
+
+
+def dynamic_view(tensor, align=16):
+    return to_cute(tensor, align).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=tensor.ndim - 1)
+
+
+def tensor_maps(specs, device):
+    """TMA descriptors (128 B each) in one device tensor.
+    Each spec: (pointer, dtype, dims, strides, box, swizzle, l2 promotion).
+
+    The bytes are uploaded with a copy on the current stream: the new tensor may
+    reuse a block freed by a kernel still pending on that stream (e.g. a warmup
+    launch's output), which a copy outside the stream would race with."""
+    encoded = bytearray()
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(torch.device(device).index):
+        for pointer, dtype, dims, strides, box, swizzle, l2 in specs:
+            u64 = ([cuda.cuuint64_t(v) for v in values] for values in (dims, strides))
+            u32 = ([cuda.cuuint32_t(v) for v in box], [cuda.cuuint32_t(1)] * len(dims))
+            interleave = cuda.CUtensorMapInterleave.CU_TENSOR_MAP_INTERLEAVE_NONE
+            fill = cuda.CUtensorMapFloatOOBfill.CU_TENSOR_MAP_FLOAT_OOB_FILL_NONE
+            status, tensor_map = cuda.cuTensorMapEncodeTiled(
+                dtype, len(dims), pointer, *u64, *u32, interleave, swizzle, l2, fill
+            )
+            if status != cuda.CUresult.CUDA_SUCCESS:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"cuTensorMapEncodeTiled failed: {status}")
+            encoded += (ctypes.c_ubyte * 128).from_address(tensor_map.getPtr())
+    return torch.frombuffer(encoded, dtype=torch.uint8).to(device)
+
+
+def _checked(result, operation="CUDA driver call"):
+    """The values of a cuda-python driver result, raising on a failed status."""
+    status, *values = result
+    if status != cuda.CUresult.CUDA_SUCCESS:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{operation} failed: {status}")
+    return tuple(values)
+
+
+class PreparedLaunchAttributes:
+    def __init__(self, compiled, executor):
+        self.compiled, self.executor = compiled, executor
+
+    def __call__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        return self.compiled(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+def resolve_kernel(compiled, device):
+    executor = compiled.to(device)
+    library = compiled.library
+    (count,) = _checked(cuda.cuLibraryGetKernelCount(library))
+    if count != 1:  # every prepared module compiles one kernel
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"expected one kernel in the compiled library, found {count}"
+        )
+    (kernels,) = _checked(cuda.cuLibraryEnumerateKernels(count, library))
+    (function,) = _checked(cuda.cuKernelGetFunction(kernels[0]))
+    return executor, function
+
+
+def check_residency(compiled, device_index: int, grid: int, threads: int, what: str):
+    """Persistent grids whose CTAs wait on one another (not only within a cluster) must
+    all be resident at once: raise when the device cannot hold ``grid`` CTAs of
+    ``compiled`` (``threads`` per CTA, its dynamic shared memory) at the same time."""
+    _, function = resolve_kernel(compiled, device_index)
+    attribute = cuda.CUfunction_attribute
+    max_dynamic = attribute.CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_DYNAMIC_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES
+    (smem,) = _checked(cuda.cuFuncGetAttribute(max_dynamic, function))
+    (per_sm,) = _checked(
+        cuda.cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(function, threads, smem)
+    )
+    sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device_index).multi_processor_count
+    if grid > per_sm * sms:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"{what}: {grid} CTAs cannot be co-resident ({per_sm} per SM x {sms} SMs)"
+        )
+
+
+def prepare_shared_carveout(compiled, device_index: int, value: int):
+    """Restore ``value`` (CuTe's launcher drops preferred_smem_carveout) as a driver
+    function attribute; call once before capture."""
+    executor, function = resolve_kernel(compiled, device_index)
+    attribute = cuda.CUfunction_attribute
+    attribute = attribute.CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_PREFERRED_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT
+    _checked(cuda.cuFuncSetAttribute(function, attribute, value))
+    return PreparedLaunchAttributes(compiled, executor)

+"""Lamport mailboxes: BF16 rows published in 16-byte fragments; a reader polls until no
+fragment holds the -0.0 sentinel, then re-arms."""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Uint32
+
+from .primitives import load_words, published, store_relaxed
+
+SENTINEL = 0x80000000
+
+
+def rearm(pointer):
+    store_relaxed(pointer, (Uint32(SENTINEL),) * 4)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def fetch(values, i: cutlass.Constexpr[int], pointer):
+    """Load fragment ``i`` into ``values[i]``; returns its dirty flag at bit ``i``."""
+    got = load_words(pointer, count=4, volatile=True)
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        values[i, k] = got[k]
+    return Uint32(not published(got)) << i
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def poll(base, stride, count: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """Lamport-poll ``count`` 16-byte fragments at base + i*stride (elements); all
+    loads issue before any check and only dirty fragments re-poll."""
+    values = cute.make_rmem_tensor((count, 4), Uint32)
+    pending = Uint32(0)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(count):
+        pending = pending | fetch(values, i, base + i * stride)
+    while pending != 0:
+        again = Uint32(0)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(count):
+            if (pending >> i) & 1:
+                again = again | fetch(values, i, base + i * stride)
+        pending = again
+    return values

+def batch_table(spec):
+    """Per-batch table of integers ("1-2:96,3-8:120"), tuples ("16:64.16.4.8") or names
+    ("16-64:trtllm"); later entries override earlier ones."""
+    table = {}
+    for item in filter(None, spec.split(",")):
+        span, value = item.split(":")
+        lo, _, hi = span.partition("-")
+        if "." in value:
+            value = tuple(map(int, value.split(".")))
+        elif value.lstrip("-").isdigit():
+            value = int(value)
+        table.update({b: value for b in range(int(lo), int(hi or lo) + 1)})
+    return table

+"""L2 weight prefetch: each warp walks a persistent device table of (address, bytes),
+spreading 16-KiB chunks over the grid in table order. The owner retains the weights
+and table through graph replay; activations and mutable caches may not be ranges
+before their producer completes."""
+
+import functools
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+from .host import fake
+from .primitives import launch, prefetch_bulk, thread
+
+
+class L2Prefetch:
+    def __init__(self, grid, carveout):
+        self.grid, self.carveout = grid, carveout
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        options = dict(pdl=False, preferred_smem_carveout=self.carveout)
+        launch(self.kernel, args, self.grid, 32, **options)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        (ranges,) = args
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        tid, _, _, block = thread()
+        worker = cutlass.Int64(block * 32 + tid)
+        workers = cutlass.Int64(self.grid * 32)
+        phase, row = cutlass.Int64(0), cutlass.Int32(0)
+        while row < ranges.shape[0]:
+            base, nbytes = ranges[row, 0], ranges[row, 1]
+            if (base != 0) & (nbytes > 0):
+                chunks = (nbytes + 16384 - 1) // 16384
+                index = worker - phase % workers
+                if index < 0:
+                    index += workers
+                while index < chunks:
+                    offset = index * 16384
+                    size = nbytes - offset
+                    if size > 16384:
+                        size = cutlass.Int64(16384)
+                    size = size & cutlass.Int64(-16)
+                    if size > 0:
+                        address = (base + offset) & cutlass.Int64(-16)
+                        prefetch_bulk(address, size.to(cutlass.Int32))
+                    index += workers
+                phase += chunks
+            row += 1
+        # Early exit must not let a later grid bypass its producer.
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def compile_kernel(count, grid, carveout, device_index):
+    ranges = fake((count, 2), None, torch.int64)
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return cute.compile(L2Prefetch(grid, carveout), ranges, make_fake_stream())

+def ptx(assembly, constraints, operands=(), result=None, *, effects, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """One verbatim asm block; a tuple ``result`` (even a 1-tuple) returns a tuple."""
+    if isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 1:
+        args = (assembly, constraints, operands, result[0])
+        return (ptx(*args, effects=effects, loc=loc, ip=ip),)
+    if result is None:
+        ir_type = None
+    elif isinstance(result, tuple):
+        ir_type = llvm.StructType.get_literal([dtype.mlir_type for dtype in result])
+    else:
+        ir_type = result.mlir_type
+    value = llvm.inline_asm(
+        ir_type,
+        [operand.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for operand in operands],
+        assembly,
+        constraints,
+        has_side_effects=effects,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    if result is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(result, tuple):
+        return tuple(
+            dtype(llvm.extractvalue(dtype.mlir_type, value, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip))
+            for i, dtype in enumerate(result)

+            kinds = [c for c in constraints.split(",") if c[:1] not in ("=", "~", "")]

+                if hasattr(v, "toint"):
+                    v = v.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+                    v = Int32(v) if kind == "r" else v
+                values.append(v)
+            return ptx(code, constraints, values, res, effects=not fx, loc=loc, ip=ip)

+    return wrap

+    op = "arrive" if arrive else "sync"
+    return f"bar.{op} {barrier_id},{count};", "~{memory}", ()
+
+
+def group_barrier(group):
+    cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=1 + 3 * group, number_of_threads=128)
+
+
+@asm()
+def sleep_ns(ns):
+    """``ns`` is an immediate if a Python int, else a register."""
+    if isinstance(ns, int):
+        return f"nanosleep.u32 {ns};", "", ()
+    return "nanosleep.u32 $0;", "r", (Uint32(ns),)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def smem_desc(pointer: cute.Pointer, swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    address = shared_address(pointer)
+    value = Uint64((address & 262143) >> 4) | Uint64(1) << 46
+    if cutlass.const_expr(swizzle):
+        value |= Uint64(1) << 16 | Uint64(64) << 32 | Uint64(2) << 61
+    else:
+        value |= Uint64(8) << 32
+    return value
+
+
+def fence_tmem(*, before=False):
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence("before_thread_sync" if before else "after_thread_sync")
+
+
+def wait_tmem(barrier, phase=0, scope="cluster"):
+    """``wait``, then order later tcgen05 operations after it."""
+    wait(barrier, phase, scope=scope)
+    fence_tmem()
+
+
+@asm()
+def free_tmem(address, columns):
+    code = f"tcgen05.dealloc.cta_group::1.sync.aligned.b32 $0,{columns};"
+    return code, "r", (Uint32(address),)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def release_tmem(tmem, columns: cutlass.Constexpr[int], warp, owner):
+    """CTA teardown: warp ``owner`` frees the TMEM after every tcgen05 operation."""
+    fence_tmem(before=True)
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+    if warp == owner:
+        fence_tmem()
+        free_tmem(tmem, columns)
+
+
+@asm()
+def require_zero_tmem(address):
+    return "{ .reg .pred p; setp.ne.u32 p,$0,0; @p trap; }", "r", (Uint32(address),)
+
+
+@asm()
+def load_tmem(address, count=1):
+    """``count`` FP32 TMEM columns of this lane, waiting for the load."""
+    registers = ",".join(f"${i}" for i in range(count))
+    code = f"tcgen05.ld.sync.aligned.32x32b.x{count}.b32 {{{registers}}},[${count}]; "
+    code += "tcgen05.wait::ld.sync.aligned;"
+    constraints = ",".join(["=f"] * count + ["r", "~{memory}"])
+    result = Float32 if count == 1 else (Float32,) * count
+    return code, constraints, (Uint32(address),), result
+
+
+@asm()
+def copy_scale(column, descriptor):
+    code = "tcgen05.cp.cta_group::1.32x128b.warpx4 [$0],$1;"
+    return code, "r,l", (Uint32(column), Uint64(descriptor))
+
+
+commit = nvvm.tcgen05_commit
+
+
+@asm()
+def commit_asm(barrier):
+    """``commit`` as an asm block on the unfolded address."""
+    code = "tcgen05.commit.cta_group::1.mbarrier::arrive::one.shared::cluster.b64 [$0];"
+    return code, "r", (barrier,)
+
+
+@asm()
+def mma_bf16_block(d, a, b, instruction, accumulate, empty, release):
+    """Warp-uniform issue of one 64-K block (K-major 128B-swizzled A and B): the
+    elected lane runs the four K16 BF16 MMAs into ``d`` (the first accumulates iff
+    ``accumulate`` is nonzero) and, if ``release``, commits ``empty``."""
+    mma = "tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1.kind::f16"
+    commit = "tcgen05.commit.cta_group::1.mbarrier::arrive::one.shared::cluster.b64"
+    code = "{ .reg .pred e,p0,pt,pc; .reg .b64 a1,a2,a3,b1,b2,b3; "
+    code += "elect.sync _|e,0xffffffff; setp.eq.b32 pt,0,0; setp.ne.b32 p0,$4,0; "
+    code += "setp.ne.b32 pc,$6,0; and.pred pc,pc,e; "
+    code += "add.s64 a1,$1,2; add.s64 a2,$1,4; add.s64 a3,$1,6; "
+    code += "add.s64 b1,$2,2; add.s64 b2,$2,4; add.s64 b3,$2,6; "
+    code += f"@e {mma} [$0],$1,$2,$3,p0; @e {mma} [$0],a1,b1,$3,pt; "
+    code += f"@e {mma} [$0],a2,b2,$3,pt; @e {mma} [$0],a3,b3,$3,pt; "
+    code += f"@pc {commit} [$5]; }}"
+    operands: tuple = (Uint32(d), Uint64(a), Uint64(b), Uint32(instruction))
+    operands += (Uint32(accumulate), empty, Uint32(release))
+    return code, "r,l,l,r,r,r,r", operands
+
+
+@asm()
+def mma_mx(d, a, b, instruction, sfa, sfb, accumulate):
+    """One block-scaled MXF8 tcgen05 MMA; ``accumulate`` is a runtime flag."""
+    words = (Uint32(v) for v in (instruction, sfa, sfb, accumulate))
+    code = "{ .reg .pred p; setp.ne.b32 p,$6,0; tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1"
+    code += ".kind::mxf8f6f4.block_scale [$0],$1,$2,$3,[$4],[$5],p; }"
+    return code, "r,l,l,r,r,r,r", (Uint32(d), Uint64(a), Uint64(b), *words)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def mma_steps(d, a, b, sfa, sfb, accumulate, fc2: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(6 if fc2 else 8):
+        a_offset: cutlass.Constexpr = k // 4 * 1024 + k % 4 * 2 + 4 * (fc2 and k >= 4)
+        instruction: cutlass.Constexpr = 142738048 | (k % 4 << 29) | (k % 4 << 4)
+        ops: tuple = (d, a + a_offset, b + k // 4 * 64 + k % 4 * 2, instruction)
+        ops += (sfa + k // 4 * 4, sfb + (k * 4 if fc2 else k // 4 * 4))
+        mma_mx(*ops, accumulate if k == 0 else 1)
+
+
+@asm()
+def chunk_mma(*args):
+    """(d, adesc, bdesc, sfa, sfa_src, sfb, sfb_src, copy_sfb, accum, empty_bar,
+    acc_bar): four K32 MMAs of one K128 chunk, with optional completion arrivals."""
+    constraints = "r,l,l,r,l,r,l,r,r,r,r"
+    types = [Uint32 if kind == "r" else Uint64 for kind in constraints.split(",")]
+    cp, mma = "tcgen05.cp.cta_group::1.32x128b.warpx4", "tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1"
+    commit = "tcgen05.commit.cta_group::1.mbarrier::arrive::one.shared::cluster.b64"
+    code = (
+        "{\n.reg .pred e,p0,pt,pc,pa,pe; .reg .b32 i<4>; .reg .b64 xa<4>,xb<4>;\n"
+        "elect.sync _|e,0xffffffff; setp.eq.b32 pt,0,0; setp.ne.b32 pc,$7,0;\n"
+        "and.pred pc,pc,e; setp.ne.b32 pa,$10,0; and.pred pa,pa,e;\n"
+        "setp.ne.b32 pe,$9,0; and.pred pe,pe,e; setp.ne.b32 p0,$8,0;\n"
+        "mov.b32 i0,142738048; or.b32 i1,i0,536870928; or.b32 i2,i0,1073741856;\n"
+        f"or.b32 i3,i0,1610612784; @pc {cp} [$5],$6; @e {cp} [$3],$4;\n"
+        "add.s64 xa0,$1,0; add.s64 xb0,$2,0; add.s64 xa1,$1,2; add.s64 xb1,$2,2;\n"
+        "add.s64 xa2,$1,4; add.s64 xb2,$2,4; add.s64 xa3,$1,6; add.s64 xb3,$2,6;\n"
+    )
+    for k in range(4):
+        code += f"@e {mma}.kind::mxf8f6f4.block_scale [$0],\n"
+        code += f"xa{k},xb{k},i{k},[$3],[$5],{'pt' if k else 'p0'};\n"
+    code += f"@pe {commit} [$9]; @pa {commit} [$10];\n}}"
+    return code, constraints, tuple(t(v) for t, v in zip(types, args))
+
+
+def launch(kernel, args, grid, block, cluster=None, pdl=True, **options):
+    """Launch kernel(args[:-1]) on stream args[-1]; an int dimension means (n, 1, 1)."""
+    dim = lambda d: d if isinstance(d, tuple) else (d, 1, 1)
+    if cluster is not None:
+        options["cluster"] = dim(cluster)
+    kernel(args[:-1]).launch(
+        grid=dim(grid), block=dim(block), stream=args[-1], use_pdl=pdl, **options
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def scatter_reduce(values, lane, count: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """Warp-reduce ``count`` values; lane groups end up owning one value each."""
+    selected = Int32(0)
+    for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        offset = 16 >> stage
+        remaining = max(count >> stage, 1)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(remaining > 1):
+            half = remaining // 2
+            upper = (lane & offset) != 0
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(half):
+                send = values[i] if upper else values[i + half]
+                keep = values[i + half] if upper else values[i]
+                values[i] = keep + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(send, offset)
+            if upper:
+                selected += half
+        else:
+            values[0] += cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(values[0], offset)
+    return values[0], selected

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Two-shot Lamport all-reduce of BF16 rows [B, width] over TP ranks.
+
+Rank ``o`` owns columns [o W, (o + 1) W), W = width / owners. Every buffer is
+Lamport-armed and only its local reader re-arms it:
+
+- ``push``: a rank stores its 8-column chunk of row ``token`` into the owner's
+  receive slot [rank] (a peer store; the owner's ``recv`` [TP, cap, W]; callers with a
+  runtime parity pass the whole [parities x TP, cap, W] and slot parity x TP + rank).
+- ``reduce``: the owner polls the TP slots of an owned chunk in its own memory, sums
+  them in FP32 in rank order, rounds once and multicasts the BF16 sum into every
+  rank's gather row [cap, width]; then re-arms the slots.
+- every rank then polls its gather row (one slot) and re-arms it.
+
+Each GPU moves ~2 x B x width x 2 bytes instead of TP x B x width x 2 (one-shot), and
+every rank gets the same bits. ``owners`` = 1 is a one-GPU stand-in: rank 0 owns every
+column and its TP local slots play the ranks. The o-projection reduces with ``reduce``
+and re-arms at once (two parities); the MoE tail reduces in WaveMoeTail and re-arms the
+previous MoE layer's rows (three parities).
+"""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint32
+
+from .mailbox import rearm
+from .primitives import (
+    add_rn,
+    at,
+    load_vector,
+    multicast_words,
+    pack_pair,
+    published,
+    store_relaxed,
+    unpack_bf16,
+    zeros,
+)
+
+SENTINEL = -0x80000000
+
+
+class TwoShot:
+    """Symmetric buffers per layer parity: ``recv`` [TP, cap, W] (this rank's owned
+    columns, one slot per source rank), ``gather`` [1, cap, width] (multicast) and the
+    ranks' ``recv`` base addresses [parity, TP]."""
+
+    def __init__(self, group, device, tp, rank, width=7168, cap=64, parities=2):
+        self.tp, self.rank, self.width = tp, rank, width
+        shape = (parities, tp, cap, width // tp)
+        bf16 = dict(dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        self.recv = symm_mem.empty(shape, **bf16)
+        self.gather = symm_mem.empty((parities, 1, cap, width), **bf16)
+        handles = [symm_mem.rendezvous(t, group) for t in (self.recv, self.gather)]
+        size = self.recv[0].numel() * 2
+        ptrs = handles[0].buffer_ptrs
+        bases = [[int(b) + p * size for b in ptrs] for p in range(parities)]
+        self.peers = torch.tensor(bases, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self.gather_mc = int(handles[1].multicast_ptr or 0)
+        if not self.gather_mc:  # views() offsets this address
+            raise RuntimeError("Kimi K3 two-shot all-reduce needs multicast memory")
+        for t in (self.recv, self.gather):
+            t.view(torch.int32).fill_(SENTINEL)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize(device)
+        torch.distributed.barrier(group=group)
+
+    def views(self, parity):
+        """(recv, peers, gather, gather multicast address) of layer parity."""
+        gather_mc = self.gather_mc + parity * self.gather[0].numel() * 2
+        return self.recv[parity], self.peers[parity], self.gather[parity], gather_mc
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def push(recv, peers, slot, token, column, words):
+    """Store this rank's BF16 chunk (token, column .. column + 7) in receive slot
+    ``slot`` of its owner."""
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr = recv.shape[2]
+    owner = column // width
+    offset = cute.crd2idx((slot, token, column - owner * width), recv.layout)
+    store_relaxed(Int64(peers[owner]) + Int64(offset) * 2, words)  # polled remotely
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def reduce(recv, gather, gather_mc, rank, token, column):
+    """Owner of (token, column): the TP slots summed in FP32 in rank order, rounded
+    once (no negative zero, the sentinel), multicast to every gather row; slots
+    re-armed. Returns nothing; callers then poll ``gather`` like a one-slot mailbox."""
+    tp: cutlass.Constexpr = recv.shape[0]
+    local = column - rank * recv.shape[2]
+    raw = zeros((tp, 4), Uint32)
+    pending = Int32((1 << tp) - 1)
+    while pending != 0:
+        for slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(tp):
+            if (pending & (1 << slot)) != 0:
+                words = load_vector(at(recv, slot, token, local), cache="volatile")
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    raw[slot, j] = words[j]
+                if published(words):
+                    pending &= ~(1 << slot)
+    values = cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Float32)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        low, high = unpack_bf16(raw[0, j])
+        for slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, tp):
+            a, b = unpack_bf16(raw[slot, j])
+            low, high = add_rn(low, a), add_rn(high, b)
+        values[2 * j], values[2 * j + 1] = low, high
+    words = tuple(
+        pack_pair(values[2 * j], values[2 * j + 1], policy="latent") for j in range(4)
+    )
+    offset = cute.crd2idx((0, token, column), gather.layout)
+    multicast_words(gather_mc + Int64(offset) * 2, words)
+    for slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(tp):
+        rearm(at(recv, slot, token, local))

+"""Split-K projection on the FlashInfer CuTe core vendored in ``splitk.py`` (with an
+evict_first weight TMA; policies map padded rows to (M tile, N tile, split K,
+stages); attention owns live slot masks)."""
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_fake_tensor
+
+from ..common.host import architecture, tensor_maps, to_cute
+from ..common.host import stream as current_stream
+from .splitk import SplitKGemm, SplitKTactic
+
+
+def matrix_view(tensor, *, output=False):
+    """Keep packed row pitches and FlashInfer's singleton-safe dynamic major axis."""
+    rows, cols = tensor.shape
+    shape = (cols, rows, 1) if output else (rows, cols, 1)
+    stride = (1, tensor.stride(0), 0) if output else (tensor.stride(0), 1, 0)
+    result = to_cute(tensor.as_strided(shape, stride))
+    return result.mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=0 if output else 1)
+
+
+@cache
+def compile_projection(tactic, output_dtype, arch):
+    """Code-only cache; weights, descriptors and activation pointers stay private."""
+
+    def fake(leading, dtype=cutlass.BFloat16):
+        shape = tuple(cute.sym_int() for _ in range(3))
+        stride = (1, cute.sym_int(64), 0) if leading == 0 else (cute.sym_int(64), 1, 0)
+        return make_fake_tensor(dtype, shape, stride, assumed_align=16)
+
+    y = fake(0, cutlass.Float32 if output_dtype == torch.float32 else cutlass.BFloat16)
+    split = SplitKTactic(*tactic)
+    kernel = SplitKGemm(tactic=split)
+    args = (fake(1), fake(1), y, y, cutlass.Int64(0), make_fake_stream())
+    return cute.experimental.compile(kernel, *args, options=f"--gpu-arch={arch}")
+
+
+def weight_map(weight, rows):
+    """Device TMA map of ``weight`` [N, K] (row pitch kept): box {64, rows}, SW128."""
+    types = cuda.CUtensorMapDataType
+    dtype = {
+        torch.bfloat16: types.CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_BFLOAT16,
+        torch.float16: types.CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_FLOAT16,
+    }[weight.dtype]
+    swizzle = cuda.CUtensorMapSwizzle.CU_TENSOR_MAP_SWIZZLE_128B
+    l2 = cuda.CUtensorMapL2promotion.CU_TENSOR_MAP_L2_PROMOTION_L2_256B
+    n, k = weight.shape
+    pitch = weight.stride(0) * weight.element_size()
+    spec = (weight.data_ptr(), dtype, (k, n), (pitch,), (64, rows), swizzle, l2)
+    return tensor_maps([spec], weight.device)
+
+
+class PreparedProjection:
+    """Split-K projection with a per-batch tactic table and caller-owned outputs."""
+
+    def __init__(self, weight, policies, *, output_dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+        if weight.dim() != 2 or weight.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"projection weight must be a BF16/FP16 [N, K] matrix, got "
+                f"{tuple(weight.shape)} {weight.dtype}"
+            )
+        pitch = weight.stride(0) * weight.element_size()
+        if weight.stride(1) != 1 or pitch % 16 or weight.data_ptr() % 16:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "projection weight rows need unit stride and a 16 B TMA pitch"
+            )
+        if output_dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+            raise ValueError(f"unsupported projection output dtype {output_dtype}")
+        self.weight, self.device = weight, weight.device
+        self.output_dtype, self.policies = output_dtype, dict(policies)
+        self.weight_view = matrix_view(weight)
+        self.kernels, self.extra, self.maps = {}, {}, {}
+
+    def prepare(self):
+        arch, dtype = architecture(self.device), self.output_dtype
+        with torch.accelerator.device_index(self.device.index):
+            for batch, tactic in self.policies.items():
+                code = compile_projection(tactic, dtype, arch)
+                self.kernels[batch] = code
+                self.extra[batch] = self.weight_map(tactic[0])
+        return self
+
+    def weight_map(self, rows):
+        """The kernel's extra argument: A's map for ``rows``-row tiles."""
+        if rows not in self.maps:
+            self.maps[rows] = weight_map(self.weight, rows)
+        return (cutlass.Int64(self.maps[rows].data_ptr()),)
+
+    def run(self, x, out):
+        y = matrix_view(out, output=True)
+        b, stream = x.shape[0], current_stream(self.device)
+        if b not in self.kernels or x.shape[1] != self.weight.shape[1]:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"projection input {tuple(x.shape)}: prepared batches "
+                f"{sorted(self.kernels)}, K {self.weight.shape[1]}"
+            )
+        code, extra = self.kernels[b], self.extra[b]
+        code(self.weight_view, matrix_view(x), y, y, *extra, stream)
+        return out

+"""FlashInfer 0.7.0.post1 ``SplitKDenseGemmKernel`` (``dense_bf16_gemm_sm100_splitk``)
+reduced to our use (PDL, no bias) with the weight (kernel-A) TMA issued through a
+device tensor map with an L2 evict_first policy, and its synchronization fixed: the
+owner waits for the peers' ``st.async`` partials at ``.acquire.cluster``; the MMA warp
+waits for TMEM-pointer phase 0 before its release arrival (else its phase-1 wait can
+pass before the epilogue has read TMEM); ``tcgen05.fence::*_thread_sync`` around
+every mbarrier hand-off of tcgen05 work.
+
+Each cluster rank accumulates an exact K slice in FP32; peers publish partials to
+rank 0 through DSMEM, which reduces, casts and stores once. Kernel-M carries public N
+and kernel-N public M."""
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as _cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cutlass.utils as utils
+import cutlass.utils.blackwell_helpers as sm100_utils
+from cutlass import Int32
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from cutlass.cute import experimental as cute_ext
+from cutlass.cute.nvgpu import tcgen05
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import dsl_user_op
+from flashinfer.gemm.kernels.dense_bf16_gemm_sm100_splitk import (
+    OWNER_RANK,
+    SplitKTactic,
+    _store_shared_remote_v4,
+)
+
+CTA_K, ATOM_K = 128, 64  # K per tile; K per 128-byte swizzle atom (one A box)
+
+__all__ = ["SplitKTactic", "SplitKGemm"]
+
+
+def _asm(code, constraints, operands, loc, ip):
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None, operands, code, constraints, has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False, asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT, loc=loc, ip=ip,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _acquire_tensor_map(tensor_map, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    code = "fence.proxy.tensormap::generic.acquire.sys [$0], 128; "
+    _asm(code + "prefetch.tensormap [$0];", "l", [tensor_map.ir_value()], loc, ip)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _tma_load_evict_first(smem, mbar, tensor_map, k0, row0, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """One {64, rows} box of A at (k0, row0), L2 evict_first."""
+    code = "{ .reg .b64 pol; createpolicy.fractional.L2::evict_first.b64 pol, 1.0; "
+    code += "cp.async.bulk.tensor.2d.shared::cta.global.tile.mbarrier::complete_tx"
+    code += "::bytes.L2::cache_hint [$0], [$1, {$2, $3}], [$4], pol; }"

+"""Weight-stationary skinny GEMM for the MoE front: y[M, N] = x[M, K] @ W[N, K]^T.
+
+Each CTA owns ``rt`` 16-row N tiles; its ``rt * kq`` warps split K into ``kq`` ranges.
+Weights enter registers and cp.async SMEM stages before the PDL wait. The epilogue
+publishes the first ``valid`` of ``split`` rows (router shard) as FP32 words at BF16
+column 3584 + 2 * (``slot`` + row) of a multicast [1, capacity, width] mailbox and the
+rest (latent down shard) as sanitized BF16 at column ``base``.
+
+``tg`` 0 is the single pass: warps load x from global and the cluster leader sums the
+K partials over DSMEM. ``tg`` > 0 streams tokens in groups of ``tg``: warp 0 bulk-copies
+the CTA's K slice of x once (one mbarrier per group) for all row tiles, and after each
+group's MMAs every warp pushes its 8-token x 16-row partial blocks to their owner CTAs
+(block % ks) with st.async; owners sum the ks * kq parts in K order and publish one
+group behind, so only the last group's blocks follow the MMA loop.

+@asm(Uint32, pure=True)
+def positive_zero(low, high):
+    """BF16 (low, high) with -0.0 halves made +0.0, so it never equals the sentinel."""
+    code = "{ .reg .b32 t; .reg .pred p,q; and.b32 t,$1,0xFFFF; "
+    code += "setp.eq.u32 p,t,0x8000; shr.u32 t,$1,16; setp.eq.u32 q,t,0x8000; "
+    code += "mov.b32 $0,$1; @p and.b32 $0,$0,0xFFFF0000; @q and.b32 $0,$0,0x0000FFFF; }"
+    return code, "=r,r", (Uint32(bf16x2(low, high)),)
+

+@asm(Float32)
+def peer_load(pointer, peer):
+    """FP32 at the same shared-memory offset in cluster CTA ``peer``."""
+    code = "{ .reg .b32 a; mapa.shared::cluster.u32 a,$1,$2; "
+    return code + "ld.shared::cluster.f32 $0,[a]; }", "=f,r,r", (pointer, Int32(peer))

+    """FP32 bits of ``value`` with -0.0 made +0.0, so it never equals the sentinel."""
+    code = "{ .reg .pred p; setp.eq.u32 p,$1,0x80000000; selp.b32 $0,0,$1,p; }"
+    return code, "=r,r", (Uint32(float_bits(value)),)

+@asm((Float32, Int32), pure=True)
+def reciprocal_guess(denominator):
+    """``sigmoid_reciprocal``'s refined fast path (IEEE mode) and whether it holds."""
+    code = "{ .reg .f32 r,error,neg_error; .reg .b32 bits; .reg .pred regular; "
+    code += "mov.b32 bits,$2; add.u32 bits,bits,0x01800000; "
+    code += "and.b32 bits,bits,0x7f800000; setp.gt.u32 regular,bits,0x01ffffff; "
+    code += "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 r,$2; fma.rn.f32 error,$2,r,0fbf800000; "
+    code += "neg.f32 neg_error,error; fma.rn.f32 $0,r,neg_error,r; "
+    return code + "selp.u32 $1,1,0,regular; }", "=f,=r,f", (denominator,)
+
+
+@asm(Float32, pure=True)
+def reciprocal_rn(value):
+    return "div.rn.f32 $0,0f3f800000,$1;", "=f,f", (value,)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def sigmoids(values):
+    """``sigmoid(v, False)`` of every value, bit for bit, with all fast paths ahead
+    of the division fallbacks' branches (verify tokens get ILP)."""
+    count: cutlass.Constexpr = len(values)
+    den = [Float32(1) + cute.math.exp(-Float32(v), fastmath=True) for v in values]
+    result, regular = zeros(count, Float32), zeros(count, Int32)
+    irregular = Int32(0)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(count):
+        result[i], regular[i] = reciprocal_guess(den[i])
+        irregular |= regular[i] ^ 1
+    if irregular != 0:  # rare: one branch for the whole batch
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(count):
+            if regular[i] == 0:
+                result[i] = reciprocal_rn(den[i])
+    return result
+

+def advance(base, n):
+    """``base + n``, or ``base`` itself for a static zero ``n`` (keeps q = 1 code)."""
+    return base + n if n else base

+    code += "st.global.L2::cache_hint.v4.f32 [$0],{$1,$2,$3,$4},pol; }"

+class KdaSplit:

+    and recurrent state [slot, head, value, key] keep their strides; slots <= 0 are
+    padding (never written) and active rows own distinct slots. Weights must be ready
+    at launch; each run waits for prior cache restoration and slot publication.
+
+    ``schedule`` = (early, lanes per state row, minimum CTAs per SM, CTAs per head);
+    zeros keep the batch defaults. Two CTAs per head give each CTA 64 state rows and
+    each gate lane two decays. Early issues every load the predecessor does not
+    produce (slot, state and conv rows, conv / F_B / norm weights) before the PDL
+    wait, converts operands at first use, and syncs the cluster only before each
+    role's first DSMEM send. Safe because those loads read only weights and data a
+    graph or non-PDL boundary orders before this launch (states and conv rows of this
+    layer's previous call or a fresh prompt's non-PDL fill, the host's slot table),
+    never same-step producer output, which is read after the wait; PDL-chained calls
+    without such a boundary must not share state slots. Early 2 also bulk-copies
+    the CTA's (contiguous) state rows to shared memory and updates four passes at a
+    time, which frees the registers that held them across the input phase; early 3
+    (two CTAs per head) also stages the gate warp's F_B rows.
+
+    ``tokens`` q > 1 (speculative verify; ``batch`` counts requests, rows b * q + t)
+    runs each request's q tokens in order with vLLM's spec cache semantics: slots
+    [B, >= q] and accepted [B] (an extra last tensor, read early like the slots); the
+    state comes from slot[b, accepted - 1] and token t's state goes to slot[b, t] if
+    > 0; conv slot[b, 0] holds [dim, q + 2] with taps at accepted - 1 ..., rewritten to
+    [c_accepted, c_accepted + 1, x_0, ..., x_q-1]. Token t's F_B row is MMA column t;
+    CTA t % C normalizes token t."""

+    def __init__(self, heads, batch, gate_mode, has_bias, schedule=(0, 0, 0), tokens=1):

+        # the decay barrier expects 512 bytes per token: more tokens would never arrive.
+        if not 1 <= tokens <= 8:

+        self.heads, self.gate_mode, self.has_bias = heads, gate_mode, has_bias
+        early, lanes, self.occupancy, cluster, evict = (*schedule, 0, 0)[:5]
+        self.early, self.staged = bool(early), early >= 2
+        self.gate_staged, self.tokens = early == 3, tokens
+        assert gate_mode != 2 or not (early or cluster)

+        # TP8 (12 heads) uses fast math; B1 releases dependents at entry.
+        self.fast_math, self.trigger_at_entry = heads == 12, batch == 1

+"""Prepared KDA core. One packed projection supplies Q/K/V, the output gate, F_A and
+beta; per-batch policies select the gate schedule and the projection row pitch."""

+from functools import cache

+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute

+# TP16 6), from GB300 sweeps: early predecessor-independent loads (MMA gate modes only;
+# 2 also stages the state rows in shared memory, 3 also the F_B operands), lanes per
+# state row, minimum CTAs per SM, CTAs per head (0: defaults) and L2 evict-first state
+# traffic (staged only).
+SCHEDULE = {12: "16-32:3.16.3.2.1,64:3.16.4.2.1", 6: "16:1.0.0,32-64:3.16.3.2"}
+# Verify (q > 1) schedules by request count B, from GB300
+# sweeps over q 4-8: no staging; eight-CTA clusters, then fewer as B grows.
+SPEC_SCHEDULE = {
+    12: "1:1.8.2.8,2-4:1.8.3.8,5-12:1.8.3.4,13-16:1.8.3.2",
+    6: "1:1.8.2.8,2:1.8.0.8,3-12:1.8.3.8,13-16:1.8.3.4",
+}

+@cache
+def executable(specs, heads, gate_mode, has_bias, device, tokens=1):
+    args = tuple(fake(shape, stride, dtype) for shape, stride, dtype in specs)
+    batch = specs[0][0][0]
+    table = SCHEDULE if tokens == 1 else SPEC_SCHEDULE
+    schedule = batch_table(table.get(heads, ""))
+    schedule = schedule.get(batch // tokens, (0, 0, 0)) if gate_mode != 2 else (0,) * 3
+    if schedule[0] >= 2 and specs[9][1][-2:] != (128, 1):  # staging needs whole rows
+        schedule = (1, *schedule[1:4])  # no evict hint without staging
+    requests = batch // tokens
+    kernel = KdaSplit(heads, requests, gate_mode, has_bias, schedule, tokens)
+    scalars = (cutlass.Float32(v) for v in (-5, 128**-0.5, 1e-6))
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        return cute.compile(
+            kernel, *args[:13], *scalars, *args[13:], make_fake_stream()
+        )
+

+def decode_conv_weight(weight):
+    """The [3, width, D] (Q, K, V) decode layout of the [3 * D, 1, width] conv
+    weight."""
+    width = weight.shape[-1]
+    return weight.detach().view(3, -1, width).transpose(1, 2).contiguous()

+
+class PreparedKda:
+    def __init__(self, attention, policies, conv_dim_first):
+        bias, dt = attention.conv1d.bias, attention.dt_bias
+        self.heads = attention.A_log.numel()
+        self.dim, self.has_bias = self.heads * 128, bias is not None
+        conv_w = decode_conv_weight(attention.conv1d.weight)
+        bias, fb = dt if bias is None else bias, attention.f_b_proj.weight
+        norm = attention.o_norm.weight.detach().float()  # BF16 slows the fused kernel
+        self.weights = (conv_w, bias, fb, attention.A_log, dt, norm)
+        self.device, self.policies = dt.device, policies
+        scalars = (attention.gate_lower_bound, 128**-0.5, attention.o_norm.eps)
+        self.scalars = tuple(map(cutlass.Float32, scalars))
+        self.conv_dim_first, self.kernels = conv_dim_first, {}
+
+    def _operands(self, caches, projected, slots, out, accepted=None):
+        """Kernel tensors in launch order: 13 before the scalars, then F_B (and the
+        verify step's accepted counts)."""
+        conv, state = caches[:2]
+        conv = conv if self.conv_dim_first else conv.transpose(-1, -2)
+        w, bias, fb, a_log, dt, norm = self.weights
+        d, h = self.dim, self.heads
+        p = lambda start, width: projected[:, start : start + width]
+        ops = (p(0, 3 * d), w, bias, conv, p(4 * d, 128), p(4 * d + 128, h), a_log, dt)
+        tail = (fb,) if accepted is None else (fb, accepted)
+        return ops + (slots, state, out, p(3 * d, d), norm) + tail
+
+    def prepare_caches(self, caches):
+        """Policy keys: a batch, or (requests, tokens) for verify steps."""
+        for key, (pitch, mode) in self.policies.items():
+            requests, tokens = key if isinstance(key, tuple) else (key, 1)
+            batch, meta = requests * tokens, dict(device="meta")
+            projected = torch.empty((batch, pitch), dtype=torch.bfloat16, **meta)
+            out = torch.empty(batch, self.dim, dtype=torch.bfloat16, **meta)
+            accepted = torch.empty(requests, dtype=torch.int32, **meta)
+            shape = (requests, tokens) if tokens > 1 else (batch,)
+            slots = torch.empty(shape, dtype=torch.int32, **meta)
+            accepted = accepted if tokens > 1 else None
+            operands = self._operands(caches, projected, slots, out, accepted)
+            self.kernels[key] = executable(
+                tuple(map(layout, operands)),
+                *(self.heads, mode, self.has_bias, self.device.index, tokens),
+            )
+        return self
+
+    def run(self, projected, out, *, caches, slots, accepted=None):
+        """``accepted`` [>= B] (verify steps): ``slots`` is [>= B, q] contiguous."""
+        batch = projected.shape[0]
+        key, rows = batch, batch
+        if accepted is not None:
+            rows = batch // slots.shape[1]
+            key, accepted = (rows, slots.shape[1]), accepted[:rows]
+            if slots.stride() != (slots.shape[1], 1):  # e.g. a block-table slice
+                slots = slots.contiguous()
+        tensors = self._operands(caches, projected, slots[:rows], out, accepted)
+        views = tuple(to_cute(t, 16) for t in tensors)
+        self.kernels[key](*views[:13], *self.scalars, *views[13:], stream(self.device))
+        return out

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
