+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The specialized decode executor over the stock Kimi K3 backbone: one routing
+decision per step, then every layer's prepared providers in one loop."""
+
+from functools import partial
+from typing import Any, NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.distributed import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce as all_reduce
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import round_up
+
+from ..cutedsl.attn_res.prepared import PreparedAttnRes
+from ..cutedsl.common.embedding import PreparedEmbedding
+from ..cutedsl.common.twoshot import TwoShot
+from ..cutedsl.moe.dense import PreparedDenseMLP
+from ..cutedsl.moe.experts_runtime import PersistentExperts
+from ..cutedsl.moe.front import SharedFront
+from ..cutedsl.moe.prepared import MoEScratch, PreparedMoE
+from ..cutedsl.moe.small_batch import chain as small_batch_chain
+from ..cutedsl.moe.tail_runtime import MoeTailBox, PreparedTail
+from ..cutedsl.oproj.prepared import OprojMailbox
+from .prefetch import PrefetchController
+from .providers import BATCHES, PREPARED_MAX, Attention, pack_front
+
+
+class Step(NamedTuple):
+    q: int  # tokens per request
+    metadata: list  # per layer
+    slot_mapping: Any
+
+
+def layer_name(module):
+    return getattr(module, "prefix", getattr(module, "layer_name", None))
+
+
+def decode_metadata(attention, context, q, b):
+    """One layer's metadata if this step is a pure decode (q = 1) or a uniform
+    verify step of b tokens, else None."""
+    md = context.attn_metadata
+    md = md.get(layer_name(attention)) if isinstance(md, dict) else None
+    if md is None:
+        return None
+    if q > 1:
+        return md if is_uniform_verify(md, q, b) else None
+    if md.num_prefills or getattr(md, "num_spec_decodes", 0):
+        return None
+    return md
+
+
+def is_uniform_verify(md, q, b):
+    """Whether every request of the b // q graph rows verifies q tokens (FULL graphs
+    pad whole requests: KDA stages NULL state rows, MLA zero-length decodes)."""
+    if md.num_prefills:
+        return False
+    if not hasattr(md, "num_spec_decodes"):
+        return md.num_decode_tokens == md.num_decodes * q == b
+    rows, tokens = md.spec_state_indices_tensor, md.num_spec_decode_tokens
+    full = rows is not None and rows.shape[0] * q == b
+    return full and not md.num_decodes and tokens == md.num_spec_decodes * q
+
+
+def caches_of(attention):
+    cache = getattr(attention, "kv_cache", ())
+    return [cache] if isinstance(cache, torch.Tensor) else list(cache)
+
+
+class SpecializedDecode:
+    """Built once the weights are loaded; owns every prepared provider, the
+    mailboxes and the decode buffers. Reads the backbone, never modifies it."""
+
+    def __init__(self, backbone, config):
+        self.backbone, self.buffers = backbone, {}
+        q = config.q
+        # Verify steps decode q tokens per request at M = requests * q tokens; FULL
+        # verify graphs round each capture size up to whole requests.
+        rounded = {round_up(s, q) for s in config.capture_sizes}
+        verify = {m for m in rounded if m <= PREPARED_MAX}
+        self.batches, self.q = tuple(sorted({*BATCHES, *verify})), q
+        self.queries = (1, q) if q > 1 else (1,)
+        # The longest sequence the deployment serves bounds the MLA split count.
+        self.max_context, self.mla_core = config.max_context, config.mla_core
+        # Decode context parallel over the TP ranks: MLA KV is sequence-sharded.
+        self.dcp, self.dcp_box, self.mla_layers = config.dcp, None, 0
+        group = get_tp_group()
+        self.tp, self.rank = group.world_size, group.rank_in_group
+        self.group = group.device_group
+        self.device = torch.device(current_platform.current_device())
+
+        layers = backbone.layers[backbone.start_layer : backbone.end_layer]
+        self.layers = layers = tuple(layers)
+        self.build_providers()
+        self.embedding = PreparedEmbedding(backbone.embed_tokens, self.tp, self.rank)
+        self.before = {
+            d.layer_idx: PreparedAttnRes.for_target(d, has_delta=d is not layers[0])
+            for d in layers
+        }
+        # The final AttnRes also applies the backbone's final norm.
+        self.final = PreparedAttnRes.for_target(backbone, final=True)
+        # The next (or final) AttnRes consumes each MoE output from its MoE tail output
+        # row.
+        self.fused_before = {}
+        followers = [self.before[f.layer_idx] for f in layers[1:]] + [self.final]
+        for layer, consumer in zip(layers, followers):
+            moe = self.feed_forward[layer.layer_idx]
+            if isinstance(moe, PreparedMoE):
+                consumer.bind_ring(moe.tail.tail_box.out.buffer)
+                self.fused_before[layer.layer_idx] = consumer
+        # The AttnRes entering each aux layer (or the final one) also stores the
+        # updated prefix: the stock aux stream (prefix sum plus the last MLP output).
+        self.aux_layers = tuple(backbone.aux_hidden_state_layers)
+        end = layers[-1].layer_idx + 1
+        for index in self.aux_layers:
+            (self.final if index == end else self.before[index]).bind_aux()
+        empty = partial(torch.empty, device=self.device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.hidden = (empty((64, 7168)), empty((64, 7168)))
+        self.prefix = empty((64, 7168))
+        self.blocks = empty((64, backbone.num_attn_res_blocks, 7168))
+
+    def build_providers(self):
+        """Every layer's attention and feed-forward providers, the model's mailboxes
+        and the prefetch side stream. All collective allocations, weight packing and
+        kernel compiles finish here, before KV binding and CUDA graph capture."""
+        config, layers = self.backbone.config, self.layers
+        beta = config.activation_situ_beta
+        linear_beta = config.activation_situ_linear_beta
+        tp, rank, device, batches = self.tp, self.rank, self.device, self.batches
+        owner = self.group, device, tp, rank
+        packed = {
+            d.layer_idx: pack_front(d.mlp, rank, tp) for d in layers if d.is_moe_layer
+        }
+        prefetch = self.prefetch = PrefetchController(self, layers, packed)
+        state = MoEScratch(tp, device, batches)
+        mailbox, tail_box, moe_layers = (
+            OprojMailbox(*owner),
+            MoeTailBox(*owner),
+            list(packed),
+        )
+        twoshot = TwoShot(*owner)
+        front_box = OprojMailbox(*owner, (1, 64, 3584 + 2 * 896))
+        small_batch = small_batch_chain.SmallBatchBox(*owner)
+        self.attention: dict[int, Attention] = {}
+        self.feed_forward: dict[int, Any] = {}
+        for layer in layers:
+            index, module = layer.layer_idx, layer.mlp
+            boxes = (mailbox, small_batch, twoshot)
+            self.attention[index] = Attention(layer, self, prefetch, *boxes)
+            if not layer.is_moe_layer:
+                reduce = all_reduce if module.down_proj.reduce_results else None
+                self.feed_forward[index] = PreparedDenseMLP(module, batches, reduce)
+                continue
+            args = (module, packed[index], front_box, state.front, batches, beta)
+            shared = dict(plan=state.plan, counters=state.shared, q=self.q)
+            front = SharedFront(*args, linear_beta, **shared)
+            routed = module.experts.routed_experts
+            w13, w2 = (
+                w.view(torch.uint8) for w in (routed.w13_weight, routed.w2_weight)
+            )
+            weights = w13, routed.w13_weight_scale, w2, routed.w2_weight_scale
+            experts = PersistentExperts(*weights, beta=beta, linear_beta=linear_beta)
+            norm = module.routed_expert_norm.weight
+            up = module.routed_expert_up_proj.weight
+            op = module.experts._k3_latent_moe_tail_op
+            placement = tail_box, moe_layers.index(index), len(moe_layers)
+            tail = PreparedTail(op, norm, up, batches, placement)
+            moe = PreparedMoE(
+                front, experts, tail, state, prefetch=prefetch, layer_idx=index
+            )
+            moe.small_batch = small_batch_chain.SmallBatchChain(
+                small_batch, module, experts, tail, index, beta, linear_beta, prefetch
+            )
+            self.feed_forward[index] = moe
+
+    def prepare_kv(self):
+        """Compile each layer's cores for its bound KV cache layout (the profiling
+        cache, then the real one)."""
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            caches = caches_of(layer.self_attn)
+            self.attention[layer.layer_idx].prepare_layout(caches)
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, ids):
+        rows = ids.shape[0] if ids.ndim == 1 and ids.is_contiguous() else 0
+        if not 1 <= rows <= PREPARED_MAX:
+            return self.backbone.embed_input_ids(ids)
+        table = self.backbone.embed_tokens.weight
+        return self.embedding.run(ids, table.new_empty((ids.shape[0], table.shape[1])))
+
+    def plan(self, positions, intermediate_tensors):
+        """This step's decode plan, or None to run the stock forward instead.
+
+        Steps that run the stock forward:
+        - pipeline-parallel stage inputs (``intermediate_tensors``);
+        - token counts without prepared providers (above 64 or not in ``batches``);
+        - steps outside a CUDA graph capture (profiling, warmup and the warmup run
+          before each capture), so every stock kernel runs before its capture;
+        - PIECEWISE steps, keyed by token count alone and so captured as stock;
+        - steps with prompt rows (prefills, chunked prefills, fresh prompts);
+        - speculative steps whose requests do not all verify q tokens (partial
+          drafts, verify rows mixed with plain decode rows).
+
+        Every predicate is the same on all TP ranks: the mailboxes of the specialized
+        decode need every rank to take the same path.
+        """
+        b = positions.shape[0]
+        if intermediate_tensors is not None or b not in self.batches:
+            return None
+        if not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            return None
+        if not is_forward_context_available():
+            return None
+        context = get_forward_context()
+        if context.cudagraph_runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE:
+            return None
+        by_layer = context.attn_metadata
+        rows: list[Any] = list(by_layer.values()) if isinstance(by_layer, dict) else []
+        q = self.q if any(getattr(md, "num_spec_decodes", 0) for md in rows) else 1
+        if b % q:
+            return None
+        metadata = [decode_metadata(d.self_attn, context, q, b) for d in self.layers]
+        if any(md is None for md in metadata):
+            return None
+        return Step(q, metadata, context.slot_mapping)
+
+    def run(self, step, input_ids, inputs_embeds):
+        """Normalized hidden states (and the aux streams) of a planned step."""
+        x = inputs_embeds
+        if x is None:
+            x = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        out = torch.empty_like(x)
+        # The stock aux streams: the AttnRes prefix entering each aux layer.
+        aux_out = [torch.empty_like(x) for _ in self.aux_layers]
+        aux = dict(zip(self.aux_layers, aux_out))
+        b, q, slots = x.shape[0], step.q, step.slot_mapping
+        prefix, blocks = self.prefix[:b], self.blocks[:b]
+        first, second = self.hidden[0][:b], self.hidden[1][:b]
+        hidden, pre_ready = x, False
+        for layer, md in zip(self.layers, step.metadata):
+            index, caches = layer.layer_idx, caches_of(layer.self_attn)
+            if not pre_ready:
+                self.before[index].run(hidden, prefix, blocks, first, aux.get(index))
+            self.attention[index].run(
+                first, second, prefix, blocks, caches, md, slots, q
+            )
+            consumer = self.fused_before.get(index)
+            pre_ready = consumer is not None
+            if consumer is not None:
+                target = out if consumer is self.final else first
+                stream = aux.get(index + 1)
+                consume = partial(consumer.run_ring, prefix, blocks, aux=stream)
+                hidden = self.feed_forward[index].run(second, target, consume=consume)
+            else:
+                hidden = self.feed_forward[index].run(second, first)
+                first, second = second, first
+        if not pre_ready:
+            self.final.run(hidden, prefix, blocks, out, aux.get(index + 1))
+        self.prefetch.join()
+        return (out, aux_out) if aux_out else out
+
+    def normalize(self, output):
+        """A stock step's output with the backbone's final norm applied, as the
+        specialized decode's last AttnRes applies it; the aux streams stay pre-norm.
+
+        Runs in chunks of at most 255 rows: the stock RMSNorm kernel reduces with
+        1024-thread blocks below 256 rows and 256-thread blocks above, so chunking keeps
+        the reduction order ``compute_logits`` uses for the few sampled rows, and
+        prefill logits match stock.
+        """
+        hidden, aux = output if isinstance(output, tuple) else (output, None)
+        norm = self.backbone.norm
+        if hidden.ndim == 2 and hidden.shape[0] >= 256:
+            chunks = range(0, hidden.shape[0], 255)
+            hidden = torch.cat([norm(hidden[i : i + 255], None) for i in chunks])
+        else:
+            hidden = norm(hidden, None)
+        return hidden if aux is None else (hidden, aux)

+"""L2 weight prefetch for the specialized decode.
+
+Small-batch decode is bound by HBM bandwidth, and each kernel that starts on weights
+not yet in L2 stalls on DRAM. Some kernels leave bandwidth idle, such as the attention
+core and the all-reduces. At fixed points of each layer, this module launches a small
+kernel (``cutedsl/common/prefetch.py``) on a side stream. It pulls the byte ranges of
+the weights the next kernels read into L2, so that they start warm.
+
+Prefetch points (``fork(point, layer, batch)``), each with its batches per TP:
+
+- ``oproj_down``: after the o-projection (B3-8), the MoE front's packed
+  router + latent-down rows.
+- ``attention_moe``: at TP8 only, after the KDA input projection (B5-8) or the MLA
+  core (B8), the same front rows plus the shared expert's weights.
+- ``next_attention``: once the routed experts are launched, the next layer's
+  attention weights, capped in MiB per batch (``NEXT_ATTENTION``). Not above B8,
+  where the HBM-bound experts lose more bandwidth than the attention gains.
+
+The front and shared-expert ranges are on the critical path. They launch with the
+highest stream priority and the maximum shared-memory carveout, which needs a driver
+launch because CuTe drops both attributes.
+
+Each fork records an event on the main stream that the side stream waits on, so a
+prefetch starts only after the work it overlaps. ``join()`` at the end of the step
+makes the main stream wait for the side stream, so a captured graph always rejoins
+it. This lives in ``runtime/`` rather than ``cutedsl/`` because it is host-side
+orchestration across layers: a stream, events, and per-(point, layer, batch) tables
+built from the model's layers.
+"""
+
+import ctypes
+from functools import partial
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import torch
+
+from ...ops.cute_dsl.latent_moe_tail.primitives import to_cute
+from ..cutedsl.common.host import _checked, resolve_kernel
+from ..cutedsl.common.policy import batch_table
+from ..cutedsl.common.prefetch import compile_kernel
+
+# Per-TP batch -> MiB cap (or cap.carveout) of the next layer's attention weights,
+# prefetched once the routed experts finish.
+# Not at B>8: the HBM-bound experts lose more bandwidth than the attention gains.
+NEXT_ATTENTION = {8: "1:96.100,2-3:96,4-7:64,8:32", 16: "1-8:1024"}
+
+
+def attention_weights(attention):
+    """Next-attention weights in their consumption order."""
+    names = (
+        *("in_proj_qkvgfab", "fused_qkv_a_g_proj", "fused_qkv_a_proj", "q_proj"),
+        *("kv_a_proj_with_mqa", "f_b_proj", "q_b_proj", "g_proj"),
+    )
+    weights = [getattr(getattr(attention, n, None), "weight", None) for n in names]
+    weights += [getattr(attention, "W_UK_T", None), getattr(attention, "W_UV", None)]
+    weights = [w for w in weights if isinstance(w, torch.Tensor)]
+    return (*weights, attention.o_proj.weight)
+
+
+class PreparedWeightRanges:
+    """One owner retains weights, immutable range table, executable and launch ABI."""
+
+    def __init__(self, weights, *, byte_cap=0, grid=32, carveout=None, priority=False):
+        self.weights = weights = tuple(weights)
+        device = weights[0].device
+        ranges, remaining = [], byte_cap
+        for weight in weights:
+            if weight.numel() == 0:
+                continue
+            if weight.data_ptr() % 16:  # the kernel walks 16-byte aligned chunks
+                raise ValueError("L2 prefetch ranges must start 16-byte aligned")
+            span = 1 + sum((n - 1) * s for n, s in zip(weight.shape, weight.stride()))
+            size = span * weight.element_size()
+            if byte_cap:
+                size = min(size, remaining) // 16 * 16
+                remaining -= size
+            if size:
+                ranges.append((weight.data_ptr(), size))
+            if byte_cap and remaining < 16:
+                break
+        self.table = torch.tensor(ranges, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self.compiled = compile_kernel(len(ranges), grid, carveout, device.index)
+        self.config = None
+        if not priority and carveout is None:
+            self.views = to_cute(self.table, 16)
+            return
+        # Launch priority / carveout need a driver launch (CuTe drops both).
+        self.executor, self.function = resolve_kernel(self.compiled, device.index)
+        ids, self.attributes = cuda.CUlaunchAttributeID, []
+        if priority:  # the greatest stream priority
+            top = cuda.CUlaunchAttribute()
+            top.id = ids.CU_LAUNCH_ATTRIBUTE_PRIORITY
+            top.value.priority = _checked(cuda.cuCtxGetStreamPriorityRange())[1]
+            self.attributes.append(top)
+        if carveout is not None:
+            smem = cuda.CUlaunchAttribute()
+            smem.id = ids.CU_LAUNCH_ATTRIBUTE_PREFERRED_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT
+            smem.value.sharedMemCarveout = carveout
+            self.attributes.append(smem)
+        config = self.config = cuda.CUlaunchConfig()
+        config.gridDimX, config.gridDimY, config.gridDimZ = grid, 1, 1
+        config.blockDimX, config.blockDimY, config.blockDimZ = 32, 1, 1
+        config.sharedMemBytes, config.attrs = 0, self.attributes
+        config.numAttrs = len(self.attributes)
+        self.pointer = ctypes.c_void_p(self.table.data_ptr())
+        self.arguments = (ctypes.c_void_p * 1)(ctypes.addressof(self.pointer))
+        self.address = ctypes.addressof(self.arguments)
+
+    def launch(self, stream):
+        if self.config is None:
+            self.compiled(self.views, stream)
+        else:
+            self.config.hStream = stream
+            _checked(cuda.cuLaunchKernelEx(self.config, self.function, self.address, 0))
+
+
+class PrefetchController:
+    """Prefetch launches per (point, layer, batch) on one side stream."""
+
+    def __init__(self, runtime, layers, packed):
+        self.device, tp = runtime.device, runtime.tp
+        self.stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=self.device)
+        self.events, self.pending, self.tables = {}, False, {}
+        urgent = partial(PreparedWeightRanges, carveout=100, priority=True)
+        following = batch_table(NEXT_ATTENTION[tp])
+        for position, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            if not layer.is_moe_layer:
+                continue
+            index, moe, attention = layer.layer_idx, layer.mlp, layer.self_attn
+            # The front GEMM reads [router shard; down shard] from the packed copy.
+            ranges = urgent((packed[index],), grid=8)
+            self._add("oproj_down", index, range(3, 9), ranges)
+            if tp == 8:
+                shared = moe.shared_experts
+                shared = shared.gate_up_proj.weight, shared.down_proj.weight
+                ranges = urgent((packed[index], *shared), grid=32)
+                batches = range(5, 9) if hasattr(attention, "in_proj_qkvgfab") else (8,)
+                self._add("attention_moe", index, batches, ranges)
+            if position + 1 < len(layers):
+                weights = attention_weights(layers[position + 1].self_attn)
+                self._add_capped("next_attention", index, weights, following)
+
+    def _add_capped(self, point, layer, weights, table):
+        groups: dict[tuple, list[int]] = {}
+        for batch, spec in table.items():
+            cap, carveout = spec if isinstance(spec, tuple) else (spec, None)
+            if cap:
+                groups.setdefault((cap, carveout), []).append(batch)
+        for (cap, carveout), batches in groups.items():
+            ranges = PreparedWeightRanges(
+                weights, byte_cap=cap * 1024**2, grid=32, carveout=carveout
+            )
+            self._add(point, layer, batches, ranges)
+
+    def _add(self, point, layer, batches, ranges):
+        key = point, layer
+        if key not in self.events:
+            event = torch.cuda.Event()
+            event.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+            self.events[key] = event
+        for batch in batches:
+            self.tables[point, layer, batch] = ranges
+
+    def fork(self, point, layer, batch):
+        ranges = self.tables.get((point, layer, batch))
+        if ranges is None:
+            return False
+        event = self.events[point, layer]
+        event.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+        self.stream.wait_event(event)
+        self.pending = True
+        ranges.launch(cuda.CUstream(self.stream.cuda_stream))
+        return True
+
+    def join(self):
+        if self.pending:
+            torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device).wait_stream(self.stream)
+            self.pending = False

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Per-layer attention providers (input projection, KDA/MLA core, o-projection) and
+the helpers ``SpecializedDecode.build_providers`` uses."""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.skinny_gemm import (
+    SkinnyGemmConfig,
+    shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import is_conv_state_dim_first
+
+from ..cutedsl.gemm.projection import PreparedProjection
+from ..cutedsl.kda.prepared import PreparedKda
+from ..cutedsl.mla.dcp import DcpBox
+from ..cutedsl.mla.prepared import PreparedMla
+from ..cutedsl.oproj.prepared import PreparedOproj
+
+# Decode batches (tokens) served by the prepared providers: every batch up to 8, the
+# padded CUDA-graph batches and each further captured size; others run stock.
+BATCHES = (*range(1, 9), 16, 32, 64)
+PREPARED_MAX = BATCHES[-1]
+
+
+def projection_policies(tp, rows, batches):
+    """Split-K (M tile, N tile, split, stages) per execution rows' next tested bin."""
+    policies = {}
+    for batch in batches:
+        n = next(b for b in (8, 16, 32, 64) if batch <= b)
+        if rows == 6288 and (tp == 8 or n > 8):
+            tactic = (64, 64, 1, 6) if n == 64 else (128, n, 2, 5 if n == 32 else 6)
+        else:  # TP16 KDA B64: a sixth stage, -0.7 us per layer in the KDA chain
+            stages = {8: 8, 16: 10, 32: 8, 64: 6 if rows == 3216 else 5}[n]
+            tactic = (64, n, 4 if n == 8 else 2, stages)
+        policies[batch] = tactic
+    return policies
+
+
+class SkinnyProjection:
+    """B1/B2 skinny GEMM; static K loads two weight tiles before the PDL wait."""
+
+    def __init__(self, weight, fallback):
+        self.weight, self.fallback, k = weight, fallback, weight.shape[1]
+        tactics = {1: (128, 4, 1), 2: (64, 4, 2)}
+        self.configs = {m: SkinnyGemmConfig(m, *t, 8, k) for m, t in tactics.items()}
+        for m, cfg in self.configs.items():  # compile before capture
+            shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm(weight.new_zeros(m, k), weight, cfg, None)
+
+    def run(self, x, out):
+        cfg = self.configs.get(x.shape[0])
+        if cfg is None:
+            return self.fallback.run(x, out)
+        return shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm(x, self.weight, cfg, None)
+
+
+def scratch(runtime, name, shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+    if name not in runtime.buffers:
+        runtime.buffers[name] = torch.empty(shape, device=runtime.device, dtype=dtype)
+    return runtime.buffers[name]
+
+
+class Attention:
+    """Input projection -> KDA/MLA core -> o-projection with its fused AttnRes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, decoder, runtime, prefetch, mailbox, small_batch, twoshot=None):
+        attention, tp = decoder.self_attn, runtime.tp
+        self.kind = kind = "kda" if hasattr(attention, "in_proj_qkvgfab") else "mla"
+        name = "in_proj_qkvgfab" if kind == "kda" else "fused_qkv_a_g_proj"
+        weight = getattr(attention, name).weight
+        pitch = weight.shape[0]
+        policies = projection_policies(tp, pitch, runtime.batches)
+        split_k = PreparedProjection(weight, policies).prepare()
+        self.projection = SkinnyProjection(weight, split_k)
+        self.core: Any  # PreparedKda or PreparedMla
+        if kind == "kda":
+            mode = lambda b: (1 if b == 1 else 2 if b <= 8 else 0) if tp == 8 else 0
+            policies = {b: (pitch, mode(b)) for b in runtime.batches}
+            q = runtime.q  # verify steps: B requests x q tokens
+            verify = [b // q for b in runtime.batches if q > 1 and b % q == 0]
+            policies.update({(b, q): (pitch, int(tp == 8)) for b in verify})
+            self.core = PreparedKda(attention, policies, is_conv_state_dim_first())
+        else:
+            heads = attention.num_local_heads
+            query = scratch(runtime, "mla.query", (64, heads, 576), torch.uint8)
+            policy = dict(max_context=runtime.max_context, core=runtime.mla_core)
+            policy.update(queries=runtime.queries)
+            if runtime.dcp > 1:
+                policy.update(
+                    dcp=dcp_box(runtime, heads), parity=runtime.mla_layers % 2
+                )
+            runtime.mla_layers += 1
+            pitches = {b: pitch for b in runtime.batches}
+            self.core = PreparedMla(attention, pitches, query, **policy)
+        parity = decoder.layer_idx % 2
+        front: tuple | None = None
+        if decoder.is_moe_layer:
+            front = small_batch.front_views[parity], small_batch.hint_views[parity]
+            front += (small_batch.batches,)
+        self.output = PreparedOproj(
+            decoder, mailbox, runtime.batches, kind == "mla", front, twoshot
+        )
+        projected = scratch(runtime, kind + ".projected", (64, pitch))
+        local = scratch(runtime, "attention.local", (64, 12288 // tp))
+        self.prefetch, self.layer = prefetch, decoder
+        self.storage = {b: (projected[:b], local[:b]) for b in range(1, 65)}
+
+    def prepare_layout(self, caches):
+        if self.kind == "kda":
+            self.core.prepare_caches(caches)
+        else:
+            self.core.prepare_cache(caches[0])
+
+    def run(self, x, out, prefix, blocks, caches, metadata, slot_mapping, q=1):
+        b = x.shape[0]
+        projected, local = self.storage[b]
+        projected = self.projection.run(x, projected)
+        if self.kind == "kda":
+            self.prefetch.fork("attention_moe", self.layer.layer_idx, b)
+            if q > 1:  # uniform q-token verify rows
+                slots = metadata.spec_state_indices_tensor
+                accepted = metadata.num_accepted_tokens
+                self.core.run(
+                    projected, local, caches=caches, slots=slots, accepted=accepted
+                )
+            else:
+                slots = metadata.non_spec_state_indices_tensor
+                self.core.run(projected, local, caches=caches, slots=slots)
+        else:
+            decode = metadata.decode
+            tables, lengths = decode.block_table, decode.seq_lens
+            # Request metadata shorter than b: the core runs the prepared batch b
+            # with the missing rows as empty requests.
+            rows = min(b, q * min(lengths.numel(), tables.shape[0]))
+            if rows < b:
+                local[rows:].zero_()
+            slots = slot_mapping[self.layer.self_attn.layer_name]
+            mla = dict(cache=caches[0], block_table=tables, lengths=lengths)
+            # DCP: lengths are the local shard's, totals the full sequences'.
+            mla.update(totals=decode.dcp_tot_seq_lens)
+            self.core.run(projected, local, slots=slots, q=q, **mla)
+            self.prefetch.fork("attention_moe", self.layer.layer_idx, b)
+        self.output.run(local, prefix, blocks, out)
+        self.prefetch.fork("oproj_down", self.layer.layer_idx, b)
+        return out
+
+
+def dcp_box(runtime, heads):
+    """The model's DCP mailboxes (one set for every MLA layer)."""
+    if runtime.dcp_box is None:
+        from vllm.distributed import get_dcp_group
+
+        group = get_dcp_group()
+        assert group.world_size == runtime.dcp == runtime.tp
+        from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config
+
+        args = group.device_group, runtime.device, group.world_size, group.rank_in_group
+        parallel = get_current_vllm_config().parallel_config
+        interleave = parallel.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size
+        runtime.dcp_box = DcpBox(*args, heads, interleave=interleave)
+    return runtime.dcp_box
+
+
+def pack_front(moe, rank, tp):
+    """[this rank's router rows (padded to 16); this rank's latent down shard]."""
+    router, down = moe.gate.weight, moe.routed_expert_down_proj.weight
+    rows, shard = 896 // tp, 3584 // tp
+    router = router[rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows]
+    down = down[rank * shard : (rank + 1) * shard]
+    return torch.cat((router, router.new_zeros((-rows % 16, 7168)), down)).detach()
